stem:
Chetan digs a small pit in the school garden in Indore and examines the soil with a hand lens.

Which statement about soil is correct?

options.text: Soil and sand are the same material, so the pit contains only sand.
Soil forms immediately the first time rainwater cracks a rock.
Soil can contain sand, insects, worms, tiny organisms and decayed plant and animal matter, and it forms over thousands of years as rocks break apart.
Soil never contains organisms too small to see with the naked eye.

teacher.key_rationale: Soil is a mixture formed slowly from rock breakup plus living and decaying matter. A equates soil with sand; B drops the long-time condition; D denies unseen organisms because they are invisible.
